explication: PenguinMod-Home is the community-facing site for discovering community-made projects and other content. The main page presents project categories and events; separate routes cover search, profiles, personal projects, messaging, uploads, and moderation. Shared authentication and project API modules support account and project operations, while localization is a cross-cutting layer. The repository also includes a VR rendering subsystem. Links reflect shown imports, rendered components, API calls, or documented product scope; unsampled route behavior is summarized without inferring its internal flow.
